headline: A festival carved out of dust, distortion & defiance.
paragraph_1: For one night the Sonoran desert becomes the loudest room in Arizona. Desert Grey is a hand-picked procession of twenty-five bands — local heroes, visiting psychonauts, debut acts still testing their amps — playing across three stages at the Nile Theater in downtown Phoenix.
paragraph_2: No lanes, no gate-keeping. From acoustic openers at sunset to doom at midnight, the lineup is built like a mixtape: it bends with the temperature.
